arxiv-2101-07733.title: Palindromic and Colored Superdiagonal Compositions
arxiv-2101-07733.creator: Jazmín Mantilla, Wilson Olaya-León, José L. Ramírez
arxiv-2101-07733.description: Abstract . A superdiagonal composition is one in which the i i -th part or summand is of size greater than or equal to i i . In this paper, we study the number of palindromic superdiagonal compositions and colored superdiagonal compositions.

arxiv-2105-04923.title: An algebraic approach to the Kuramoto model
arxiv-2105-04923.creator: Lyle Muller, Ján Mináč, Tung T. Nguyen
arxiv-2105-04923.description: Abstract We study the Kuramoto model with attractive sine coupling. We introduce a complex-valued matrix formulation whose argument coincides with the original Kuramoto dynamics. We derive an exact solution for the complex-valued model, which permits analytical insight into individual realizations of the Kuramoto model.

arxiv-2105-10441.title: Driving-Signal Aware Full-Body Avatars Journal: TOG Volume: 40 4 143 8 DOI: 10.1145/3450626.3459850 CCS: Computing methodologies Neural networks CCS: Computing methodologies Animation

arxiv-2105-10441.description: Abstract . We present a learning-based method for building driving-signal aware full-body avatars. Our model is a conditional variational autoencoder that can be animated with incomplete driving signals, such as human pose and facial keypoints, and produces a high-quality representation of human geometry and view-dependent appearance.

arxiv-2108-11461.title: Optical solitons and vortices in fractional media: A mini-review of recent results
arxiv-2108-11461.creator: Boris A. Malomed 1,2
arxiv-2108-11461.description: Abstract The article produces a brief review of some recent results which predict stable propagation of solitons and solitary vortices in models based on the nonlinear Schrödinger equation (NLSE) including fractional one- or two-dimensional diffraction and cubic or cubic-quintic nonlinear terms, as well as linear potentials.

arxiv-2206-13585.title: Heterogeneous mixtures of dictionary functions to approximate subspace invariance in Koopman operators
arxiv-2206-13585.creator: Charles A. Johnson, Shara Balakrishnan, Enoch Yeung
arxiv-2206-13585.description: Abstract Koopman operators model nonlinear dynamics as a linear dynamic system acting on a nonlinear function as the state. This nonstandard state is often called a Koopman observable and is usually approximated numerically by a superposition of functions drawn from a dictionary .

arxiv-2207-09033.title: Using the Newton-Raphson Method with Automatic Differentiation to Numerically Solve the Implied Volatility of Stock Options via the Binomial Model
arxiv-2207-09033.creator: Wanchaloem Wunkaew, Yuqing Liu, and Kirill V. Golubnichiy
arxiv-2207-09033.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Wanchaloem Wunkaew, Yuqing Liu, and Kirill V. Golubnichiy. In the paper by Michael Klibanov et al. [ 3 ] , a novel method is proposed to calculate the implied volatility of European stock options as a solution to the ill-posed inverse problem for the Black-Scholes equation. Additionally, the paper introduces a trading strategy based on the difference between the implied volatility of the option and the volatility of the underlying stock.

arxiv-2207-10602.title: Entropic Density Functional Theory
arxiv-2207-10602.creator: Ahmad Yousefi, Ariel Caticha
arxiv-2207-10602.description: Abstract A formulation of the Density Functional Theory (DFT) is constructed as an application of the method of maximum entropy for an inhomogeneous fluid in thermal equilibrium. The use of entropy as a systematic method to generate optimal approximations is extended from the classical to the quantum domain.

arxiv-2208-11826.title: Far-field diffraction computational imaging based on parameter-robust illumination and direct phase optimization Journal: opticajournal Publication type: Research Article
arxiv-2208-11826.creator: An-dong Xiong, 1,2 Xiao-peng Jin, 1 Xv-ri Yao, 1 and Qing Zhao 1,*
arxiv-2208-11826.description: Abstract Coherent diffraction imaging (CDI) is a promising imaging technique revealing most of the information from diffraction measurements. An ideal CDI should reconstruct complex-valued object from a single-shot far-field diffraction without any priori information about the target. To realize the ideal CDI, we propose a class of parameter-robust illumination pattern.

arxiv-2309-01382.title: A symmetry perspective of the Riemann zeros
arxiv-2309-01382.creator: Pushpa Kalauni a, Prasanta K. Panigrahi b
arxiv-2309-01382.description: Abstract We study the relationship between the zeros of the Riemann zeta function and physical systems exhibiting supersymmetry, P ​ T PT symmetry and S ​ U ​ ( 2 ) SU(2) group symmetry. Our findings demonstrate that unbroken supersymmetry is associated with the presence of non-trivial zeros of the zeta function.

arxiv-2411-04680.title: Privacy Leakage via Output Label Space and Differentially Private Continual Learning
arxiv-2411-04680.creator: Marlon Tobaben marlon.tobaben@csc.fi
arxiv-2411-04680.description: Abstract Differential privacy (DP) is a formal privacy framework that enables training machine learning (ML) models while protecting individuals’ data. As pointed out by prior work, ML models are part of larger systems, which can lead to so-called privacy side-channels even if the model training itself is DP.

These magnetic fields evolve via magnetohydrodynamic processes until the epoch of recombination.

pmc-10575890.creator: Zhenfen Li, Ziyue Yang, Yuanyuan Zhu, Chunmeng Fu, Ning Li, Fang Peng
pmc-10575890.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). A high recurrence rate and easy metastasis are two prominent clinical features of hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), which is also the most common cause of cancer-related death. However, the molecular pathogenesis of HCC remains unclear. Soluble resistance-related calcium-binding protein (Sorcin) is highly expressed in a variety of tumor cell lines and multidrug-resistant cell lines and participates in the malignant progression of tumors by regulating apoptosis.

The voltammograms obtained showed remarkable differences between the two monomers and between the two electrode materials.

pmc-11458624.title: Optimization of small coal pillar width and control measures in gob-side entry excavation of thick coal seams
pmc-11458624.creator: Yan-ping Xue
pmc-11458624.description: This study introduces an innovative optimized bolting support system specifically tailored for gob-side entry excavation in thick coal seams at a coal mine in southwestern Shandong, China. Employing theoretical analysis, numerical simulation, and field measurements, the research focuses on examining the failure characteristics of surrounding rock during gob-side entry excavation.

pmc-11533152.title: Thin, Uniform, and Highly Packed Multifunctional Structural Carbon Fiber Composite Battery Lamina Informed by Solid Polymer Electrolyte Cure Kinetics
pmc-11533152.creator: Mohamad
pmc-11533152.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Multifunctional structural batteries promise advancements in structural energy storage technologies by seamlessly integrating load-bearing and energy-storage functions within a single material, reducing weight, and enhancing safety. Yet, commercialization faces challenges in materials processing, assembly, and design optimization. Here, we report a systematic approach to develop a carbon fiber (CF)-based structural battery impregnated with epoxy-based solid polymer electrolyte (SPE) via robust vacuum-assisted compression molding (VACM). Informed by cure kinetics, SPE processing enhances the multifunctional performance with no fillers or additives.
